claim_text: Among 93 age-matched untreated NF1 patients in the NCI natural-history study, 73 (78%) had a plexiform neurofibroma volume increase of at least 20% over 3.2 years, with 15% progression-free at 3 years (median 1.3 years), and none had shrinkage of more than 20%.
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). Comparator is a non-randomized external natural-history cohort (NCT00924196).
source_title: Selumetinib in Children with Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas
